Spent the whole weekend reorganizing the garage, which somehow turned into sorting three decades of my dad's fishing gear, a box of cassette tapes I swear I threw out in 2004, and enough mismatched screws to build a second house. Found my old bike though, and it still rides.

Quick update on the community garden: the tomatoes finally came in, the zucchini situation is out of control again, and someone keeps leaving very polite notes about the compost bin lid. If you want squash, come by Saturday morning, bring a bag, and please close the lid.
